data.name: Stellar Industrialist
data.detailed_description:
In a constantly shifting starfield where borders are redrawn and alliances crumble overnight,
you are neither a general nor a soldier — but a profit-driven Stellar Industrialist.
The fiercer the battles, the faster your factories flourish; peace is nothing but shutdowns and losses.
Venture to the frontlines, scour the battlefields for wreckage and salvage, then reinvest those spoils to expand your interstellar arms empire.

Key Features

  • Dynamic Starfield: Procedurally generated planets and faction territories that evolve over time — no two galaxies play the same.

  • Heat System: The tenser the front, the higher the heat; intense conflicts boost drop rates and drastically increase your profits.

  • Armed Intervention: Build ships and sell them to any faction — your arms deals directly tip the balance of power on the frontline.

  • Ship Manufacturing: Dozens of ship types and upgrade routes to grow your industrial pipeline and weaponize the economy itself.
